visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a white graphic t-shirt, stands in a bright indoor room. He holds a black shoulder bag and gestures impatiently toward a white closed door, looking at his wrist as if checking the time. (2) A second person wearing a long brown wig and a white t-shirt peeks out from behind the white door, looking stressed and apologetic. They gesture defensively with their hands against the door frame in a medium shot. (3) The man checks a black smartphone, looking up with an exaggerated eye roll and an annoyed facial expression. The person in the wig continues to peek out, gesturing toward their chest with a hand. (4) The setting shifts to a dimly lit version of the room where the character in the wig is seen on the floor, crawling toward the camera with a distressed expression, looking directly into the lens while messy hair falls over their face. (5) A white and red product box with Chinese text falls from above into the frame against a plain white wall. The man, now seated at a wooden desk with an open laptop, holds the product box up, smiling and pointing at it enthusiastically. (6) A series of fast-paced cuts shows the person in the wig consuming a small stick-shaped supplement and then both characters performing a synchronized, energetic dance with various hand gestures and finger hearts. (7) The video concludes in the brightly lit room with the man looking relieved, hands clasped, while the person in the wig holds the product box confidently next to him, ready to leave the house.
